panels.shot: ER entrance, rain and the red neon cross. Elias carries Mags through sliding glass doors; her blood on his white shirt. A nurse pushes a gurney toward them. Nero runs alongside.

lines.text: I paid in Choir gold. In this hospital, gold buys a bed and no questions.

panels.shot: Room 314, green monitor light. Mags lies unconscious, her shoulder bandaged. Nero sits at the bedside, alert. Elias puts his hand on the dog's head.
Corridor, flickering lights. Men in white coats walk toward camera in a line. One unwraps a scalpel from cloth. A tuning fork pin glints on a lapel (red tint).

lines.text: Choir rule: gold buys care. But someone had paid more.

panels.shot: Lightning flash. The power dies. Black panel; only Elias's eyes and a scalpel's edge catch the light.

lines.text: Lights out. My kind of medicine.
